findings.title: Locale tag @locale:nl is not an axis tag
findings.body: The guideline lists site, environment and device axis tags; this tag is not one of them.
findings.quote: test('the list shows a short note in dutch', { tag: ['@locale:nl', '@notes'] }, async ({ notes }) => {
